title: mail-briefing settings (agentbay.config.yaml modes.mail-briefing): the briefing settings plus `important`

lookback.description: Default window for sync, digest and ask (e.g. 3d, 12h). Capped by lookbackMax.

retention.description: prune drops items older than this.

selectors.description: Which items to keep (bay/selector.py): fields ANDed, selectors ORed, `not` excludes. Changing them re-matches stored items on the next sync; a new selector backfills its lookback; prune drops items no selector matches.

important.description: Senders whose items weigh more in the digest: handles, addresses or domains, `*` wildcard (the selector `from` rules). The store marks threads with a message from one of them.

costPerPostUsd.description: Price per item a source reads, for the spendUsd cap. Unset: bay/config.py COST_PER_POST_USD; a connector may declare its own (fake: 0).
